# Avec Anima

> Avec Anima is an underground house and tech house night on the Isle of Man, running events at venues across the island — from Douglas clubs to one-off nights in the glens.

Contact: hello@avecanima.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/avec.anima/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61553040350027
SoundCloud: https://soundcloud.com/anima-937658688
Store: https://kp1kgw-bb.myshopify.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://avecanima.com/): Next upcoming events, featured live set and merch
- [Events](https://avecanima.com/events.html): Full list of upcoming and previous events
- [Gallery & After Movies](https://avecanima.com/gallery.html): After movies and photo galleries from past events
- [Music](https://avecanima.com/music.html): Live sets on YouTube and playlists curated by the Avec Anima selectors on SoundCloud

- None announced yet — check the events page.
